material.name: Bambu PA6-CF, printed, transversely isotropic (layer plane XY, build direction Z)
material.source: https://store.bblcdn.eu/s8/default/a64af9edb0f64095ad18bc4ad4faf1ec/Bambu_PA6-CF_Technical_Data_Sheet-v2.pdf (Technical Data Sheet V3.0, ISO 527 / ISO 1183, specimens 100 % infill, annealed and dried 80 C 12 h)

assumptions.nu_xz: 0.30 not in the TDS (load in the layer plane, contraction along Z)
assumptions.g_z_mpa: E_z/(2(1+nu)), interlayer shear modulus not in the TDS
assumptions.state: dry, annealed, 100 % infill; no moisture, voids, plasticity, fatigue or strain rate

sources.arm_tip: motor thrust 1.80 N (GTS V3 1203 8000KV, GF65R, 7.4 V) x 2, upward on the front-left motor seat, centre mounts fixed
sources.crash_front: all-up mass 125 g x 25 g = 30.6 N rearward on the camera region, centre mounts fixed
sources.crash_arm: all-up mass 125 g x 12.5 g = 15.3 N on the front-left motor seat, oblique (inward, tangential, downward 2:2:1 normalised), centre mounts fixed
sources.crash_back: ASSUMPTION: all-up mass 125 g x 12.5 g = 15.3 N on the battery deck towards the frame (landing on the back), four motor seats fixed
sources.safety_factor: 2.0 against TDS tensile strength, linear static equivalent load, no impact dynamics

support.modes: four motor seat undersides fixed (all translations), battery as rigidly coupled point mass on the deck band
